correctness.rationale: For every positive a,b,c,d the word 0^a1^b0^c1^d has at most three transitions in a factor. Zero-transition maximal closed occurrences are precisely four whole runs; one-transition factors are not closed; two-transition closed words require balanced outer unary runs, with exactly one deletion at the crossing extension when c≤a or b≤d; three-transition closed words have border 0^x1^y for x≤c and y≤b and a unique maximal occurrence at x=min(a,c), y=min(b,d). These disjoint exhaustive cases give K=5+min(a,c)+min(b,d)−I(c≤a)−I(b≤d). Compositional floor inequalities, explicit upper/lower witnesses, and a continuous intermediate family prove the complete fixed-n interval {5,...,floor(n/2)+4} for n≥5 and {5} for n=4. Independent direct factor-and-overlap border enumeration reproduced every endpoint for all 1296 tuples with a,b,c,d≤6 and all attainable spectra n=4..19; this is supplemental to the all-length proof.
